ns2:course.label: Recent Trends in Geog Thought
ns2:course.description: Examination of recent trends in human and physical geography. Themes include empiricism, logical positivism, regionalism, Marxism, realism, phenomenology, and post-modernism as applied to geographic research. Emerging geographic literature is explored to identify the latest conceptual developments. 4 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to students with Graduate class standing.
